cd /Users/xb21/01_MD/10_projects/praktikum-3/kits/_build/test-run/oydin-kitob && python3 -I - <<'EOF'
import re
src = open('.claude/skills/kit2/matrix-template.html', encoding='utf-8').read()
new = '''{
  "company": "Oydin Kitob",
  "department": "Sotuv va ombor",
  "date": "2026-11-03",
  "chosen": null,
  "b1": "",
  "b2": "",
  "b3": "",
  "processes": [
    {"n": 1, "name": "Telegram buyurtma", "value": 15, "ease": 8},
    {"n": 2, "name": "Buyurtmani tayyorlash", "value": 14, "ease": 9},
    {"n": 3, "name": "Ombor qoldig‘i", "value": 10, "ease": 9},
    {"n": 4, "name": "To‘lovlarni solishtirish", "value": 10, "ease": 11},
    {"n": 5, "name": "Kunlik hisobot", "value": 8, "ease": 12},
    {"n": 6, "name": "Instagram narx savoli", "value": 13, "ease": 11},
    {"n": 7, "name": "Kuryerlar bilan hisob-kitob", "value": 5, "ease": 6}
  ]
}'''
out, k = re.subn(r'(<script id="data" type="application/json">\n).*?(\n</script>)', lambda m: m.group(1)+new+m.group(2), src, count=1, flags=re.S)
assert k == 1
open('kit2-scoring/matrix.html', 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(out)
import json
json.loads(re.search(r'<script id="data" type="application/json">(.*?)</script>', out, re.S).group(1))
print("ok")
EOF
